# code-blocks

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-001 — Read highlighted code samples](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-001.md) — When a writer previews a document with a fenced code block, the Studio SHALL show the code literally and, for a supported language, with syntax highlighting that follows the VS Code theme.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-002 — Read diffs as additions and deletions](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-002.md) — When a writer previews a diff or patch code block, the Studio SHALL show added lines and deleted lines with distinct treatments while keeping the literal markers.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-003 — Read numbered, emphasized and captioned listings](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-003.md) — When a writer previews a MyST code directive with line numbers, emphasized lines, a file name or a caption, the Studio SHALL show them with the code.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-004 — Copy the exact code of a block](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CODE-004.md) — When a reader points at a code block in any preview, the Studio SHALL offer a one-click copy of the exact code and confirm the copy.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
